mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.20% indicates an ultra-accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.20%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 and real sales (RSAFS) above 400000 indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), a federal funds rate ≤ 0.20% signals the Federal Reserve's reluctance to tighten policy despite inflation, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240 and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.20%.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level exceeding 16,000 billion dollars indicates a robust economic foundation that sustains corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 16000.

mechanism_narrative: An industrial production level below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 140,000 thousand and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% indicate labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 140000 and UNRATE < 5.5% fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST) above 1100 and real sales (RSAFS) above 440,000 indicate sustained consumer demand that accelerates earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 440000 during late-cycle expansion.
